definitions.explanation: Originally referred to the balance of salt and plum vinegar in cooking. Now used more broadly for the balance of seasonings and taste.
Extended to describe the general state or condition of something, how something is going, or the way something is done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩梅|あんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ちょうどいい→ちょうどいい：21521_choudoii⟧。
examples.english: The salt seasoning is just right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩梅|あんばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{調味料|ちょうみりょう}→調味料：04941_choumiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧。
examples.english: Add seasonings while checking the flavor balance.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{塩梅|あんばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{焼|や}けた→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧。
examples.english: It cooked to just the right degree.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩梅|あんばい}はどうです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩梅|あんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{困|こま}っている→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: Things aren't going well at work and I'm having a hard time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{塩梅|あんばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's decide whether to go out depending on how the weather looks.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) + {梅|うめ}{酢|ず} (plum vinegar) = {塩梅|あんばい}
Originally referred to the traditional Japanese seasoning method using salt and plum vinegar.

ALTERNATIVE WRITING:
Also written as {按排|あんばい} or {按配|あんばい} when emphasizing the "arrangement" meaning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{塩梅|あんばい} - just right, in good condition
- {塩梅|あんばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ - to check the condition/seasoning
- {塩梅|あんばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - in poor condition
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{塩梅|あんばい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - just right, moderately

USAGE:
{塩梅|あんばい} conveys a sense of balance and appropriateness. When used for conditions, it suggests finding the right balance or moderate state.
